training_metadata.architecture: 2->32->32->2 ReLU, endpoint envelope, physical norm cap

normalizer.fitted_on: training sources only, source-uniform arc-cell quadrature times fixed observed/interpolated kind weights

training_metadata.sample_weighting: Irregular observed/gap-interpolated points weighted by trapezoidal arc-cell width times label weight, then normalized to unit total weight per source; no uniform path resampling
training_metadata.contour_confidence: Uncalibrated extraction heuristic retained as evidence; not used as a training or evaluation loss weight
training_metadata.endpoint_policy: learn shape relative to observed start/end line; robot retargets exact end to bearing center
training_metadata.retiming: Arc-length progress and 40mm/s robot command speed; original human timing is not learned
training_metadata.rotation_translation_augmentation: Analytical local-frame equivariance; no extra independent source recordings
training_metadata.runtime_inputs: start/goal/progress only; held-out motion paths never read by controller
training_metadata.hybrid_controller: Neural XY in transfer; geometric XY/Z/gripper in other phases; geometric Z/gripper in transfer
limitations: Approximate uncalibrated image-plane XY; not 3D pose
Test sources are from same concatenated recording

controller_scope: Learned XY transfer; geometric approach, grip, vertical lift, lower, release and retract. Shared FSM, IK, servo and physics.
step_count_definition: learned_steps means learned-transfer scope, including deterministic endpoint steps; neural_forward_calls counts actual forward passes. Z and gripper remain geometric during transfer. planned_steps counts other stages and all zero-residual baseline stages.
placement_criteria: Full ring projection in hole with 0.3mm margin, tilt <=8deg, table height within1.5mm, speed<0.01m/s, angular speed<0.15rad/s, open fingers, zero finger contact, settled >=0.4s.
limitation: Same original held-out sources as V1/V2; correlated synthetic descendants, not new human recordings or an independent real-world benchmark.
